description: Find which approval level a deal needs under your own approval matrix (delegation of authority) before the quote goes out. Send the matrix as levels from lowest to highest authority, each with its highest discount percent, longest contract term in months and longest payment terms in days, and the deal's discount (or list and net price), term and payment days. Get back the lowest level that can approve every part of the deal, which part drove it, the level each part needs on its own, and a plain flag when no level in the matrix can approve it. Answer fields: ok, verdict, result, rule, does_not, sources, observation, signature, verify. Errors: ok false with the reason (bad input, too large, hourly limit). Free. No model, no network, nothing you send is stored by the tool, and every answer is signed with LLPRO's key (check it at https://llpro.ai/discount-approval-check). Labels are your own text: emails, web addresses and long digit runs are refused. Not legal, tax or financial advice.

discount_percent.description: The deal's discount in percent. Or send list_price and net_price instead.

label.description: Optional label for the deal (your own text, echoed; up to 6 digits in a row).

levels.description: Approval levels (1 to 20), lowest authority first (for example rep, sales manager, VP sales, CFO).

level.description: Level name, a role, e.g. 'Sales manager' (not a person's name; up to 6 digits in a row).

max_discount_percent.description: Highest discount this level may approve, in percent (leave out for no limit).

max_payment_days.description: Longest payment terms this level may approve, in days, e.g. 30 for net 30 (leave out for no limit).

max_term_months.description: Longest contract term this level may approve, in months (leave out for no limit).

list_price.description: List price of the deal (with net_price, instead of discount_percent).

net_price.description: Net (quoted) price of the deal, after the discount.

payment_days.description: Optional: payment terms in days (net 45 = 45; 0 = due on receipt).

name: discount_approval_check
title: Deal Discount Approval Check
